title: Use one evolution owner URL and fix evolution test isolation
summary: Unified evolution owner backend URL resolution to read solely PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL across both command_executor and command_adapters/base.py, removing legacy fallback to PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_API_URL. Fixed test environment variable leakage in test_command_executor.py by adopting patch.dict + addCleanup for PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL. Added autouse delenv fixture in test_evolution_program_owner_contract.py to ensure hermetic test execution. Updated router test stubs in test_evolution_program_owner_contract.py, evolution/test_router.py, and test_bff_evolution_experiment_jobs_events_contract.py to accept authorization and assert its forwarding per commit dab9aa6c2. All 81 scoped tests pass deterministically in both forward and reverse order with zero assertion weakening.

evolution_owner_url_single_env.evidence: command_adapters/base.py evolution_url now calls get_base_url('PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL') with no fallback to PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_API_URL, matching command_executor._evolution_url.

test_environment_isolation_and_order_ind.evidence: test_command_executor.py setUp methods now use patch.dict(os.environ, {'PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL': 'http://localhost:5001'}) with self.addCleanup(patcher.stop) instead of polluting ambient os.environ. test_evolution_program_owner_contract.py uses an autouse monkeypatch.delenv fixture. Tests pass in forward and reverse orders (81 passed in both directions).

router_stubs_authorization_forwarding.evidence: Stubs in test_evolution_program_owner_contract.py, evolution/test_router.py, and test_bff_evolution_experiment_jobs_events_contract.py accept authorization=None. Forwarding assertions verify that authorization tokens from client requests are forwarded directly to the injected action handlers matching commit dab9aa6c2.

all_scoped_tests_pass_without_regression.evidence: All 81 tests pass across the four scoped test files, and related evolution suites (test_evolution_program_action_receipts, test_evochain_004, test_evochain_005, test_receipt_owner_routes) remain green.

classifications.rationale: base.evolution_url still fell back to PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_API_URL while command_executor read only PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL since e87c896fd; fixed in production code by removing the fallback.
Tests still configured PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_API_URL without cleanup from before e87c896fd separated evolution from governance; updated to set PANTHEON_EVOLUTION_API_URL via patch.dict and addCleanup.
Added hermetic delenv fixture and aligned _submit_program_action_unavailable stub signature with dab9aa6c2 authorization parameter.
Aligned submit_program_action stub signature with dab9aa6c2 authorization parameter and added assertion verifying forwarding.
Aligned _submit_prog_action, _submit_exp_action, and _submit_job_action stubs with dab9aa6c2 authorization parameter and added forwarding assertions.

net_prod_line_budget.evidence: Production code changes in services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/base.py result in 0 net lines (+1, -1), well under the 10 net line budget for change_class=corrective. No compressed code used.
